description: Generate a 90-day social media calendar in High Level CRM, 1 post ever 2 days. (HL Social Planner CSV): pulls the client's sitemap for using link-back URLs and post topics, AI writes posts + images per post, with or without HighLevel connection. Requires HighLevel to import data but optional, will ask for details if needed. Requires AI model for content, image API + SSH/FTP host for image uploads.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
